limitations: Prepared results cover only the first archived 42-fit cohort of photo 1029, not whole-image fitting.
Full CPU-fitting controls retain the hybrid encoder Metal stages. Continuous CPU fitting uses a 16 Mi sample feature window; all cohort routes use 8 Mi.
Managed backing is not RSS. Common archives, driver/profiler allocations and oracle outputs are outside operation accounting.
No additive CPU/GPU throughput or GPU occupancy improvement is established by these timings.
The initial prepared sweep stopped on an overly strict requirement that admitted capacity be fully occupied. Its partial observations are excluded.
Sanitizer validation disables leak detection and suppresses only the preexisting metal-cpp NSObject.hpp null-message diagnostic; libjxl decoder is not instrumented.

prepared_case.boundary: Complete fitting including validation, scratch, partition, node/queue management, canonicalization and publication. GPU upload included. Input sampling, CPU input restoration, backend/domain and worker-pool creation excluded. Concurrent thread launch/join included. CPU seconds are process CPU time.

full_boundary: Complete private encode; excludes backend/domain creation, file IO, independent decode and hashing
